summary.text: In September and October 2026 posts, Sean P. Duffy promoted FAA artificial intelligence tools such as SMART and Trajectories, saying they use live data to reroute flights, predict weather disruptions, and reduce delays and cancellations. He also said new AI software would not replace air traffic controllers and that a human would always manage U.S. airspace, with AI providing information to them. In other statements, he described using AI to identify safety hotspots and fraud patterns and called for American-developed technology and innovation.
